'''Quadrant A-89''' was a section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
The [[Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters (Quadrant A-89)|Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters]] was located in this sector,<ref name="RC:TZ" /> and at the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] were based here.<ref name="LOTF:B" />
